    Good to know

    Before you book.

    Sessions in these programs run 60 minutes. Come about ten minutes early so you are not starting the hour out of breath.

    Programs are valid for twelve months from the date of purchase. There is no schedule you have to keep to inside that — book the sessions as they suit you.

    Memberships can be paused or cancelled at any time. Nothing has to be arranged in advance.

    Yes. Every purchase includes private VIP room access. If you have booked for two, you are on the table side by side and the room is still only yours.

    Reset. One session, no commitment after it, and enough of the room to know whether you want more. Most people who go on to a program started there.
